integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the model definition, density, moment transformation, all six estimation criteria, observed-information interval, and scale-simulation discussion. Broader distribution-transformation literature and the closest previous same-model result were compared at statement level. The transformation and finite-sample equivariance statements are algebraic, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: Exact scale equivariance is a property of the mathematical optimization criteria; numerical implementations can introduce non-equivariant error.
Independent Monte Carlo tables at different scales may differ because of simulation noise.
The Gamma representation does not make every transformed moment elementary.
title: The modified Muth law is exactly a log-Gamma scale family
